findings.violated_contract: Parent Epic E1-REQ-005 requires a P2/P3-only Review to leave the Candidate unchanged. The Issue design defines P2 as a review finding, the revision request accepts finding IDs without a blocking-severity restriction, and S07 directs revision whenever findings exist.
findings.concrete_impact: A P2-only Review can enter Semantic or Mechanical revision and generate a new Candidate identity, version, filename or ZIP SHA even though the parent contract prohibits Candidate mutation for that result, so the implemented dogfood path cannot deterministically conform to E1-REQ-005.
findings.minimal_correction_boundary: Preserve the current Review schema and both revision lanes, but constrain the existing revision trigger and request validation to P0/P1 findings; a P2-only result must leave the Candidate unchanged.
